acquisition_method: DDA MS analysis was performed for downstream spectral library generation for downstream DIA MS (Figure 1).
alkylation_concentration: Filters with immobilized proteins were then incubated with 8 M urea buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min in the dark.
alkylation_reagent: Filters with immobilized proteins were then incubated with 8 M urea buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min in the dark.
cleavage_agent: Proteins were then digested with trypsin (enzyme:protein ratio of 1:50) at 37 °C for 16 h under agitation (600 RPM).
collision_energy: The 15 most abundant peaks from the MS scan (resolution: 70,000 at 200 m/z) were selected and fragmented by higher energy induced collision dissociation (HCD, collision energy: 30).
fractionation_method: For DDA MS analysis (sample set 1), a total of 50 μg of the protein content was digested for each sample followed by strong anion-exchange fractionation following previously described protocols.
fragmentation_method: The 15 most abundant peaks from the MS scan (resolution: 70,000 at 200 m/z) were selected and fragmented by higher energy induced collision dissociation (HCD, collision energy: 30).

instrument.evidence: For DIA MS analysis (sample sets 1 and 2), a Q-Exactive HF-X (Thermo Fisher) mass spectrometer was employed.

labeling: DDA-derived RAW files were analyzed using MaxQuant (v1.6.0.16). MS spectra were searched using the Andromeda built-in search engine against the Uniprot-Swissprot human proteome database (version download 2017.06.12). Label-free quantification (LFQ) and match between run options were enabled.
mass_analyzer: inferred: For DIA MS analysis (sample sets 1 and 2), a Q-Exactive HF-X (Thermo Fisher) mass spectrometer was employed.

ptm.value: carbamidomethylation of Cys residues; acetylation of the N-terminal residue; oxidation of Met residues
ptm.evidence: Fixed modifications: carbamidomethylation of Cys residues. Precursor ion tolerance: 20 and 4.5 ppm for first and main searches, respectively. Variable modifications: acetylation of the N-terminal residue, oxidation of Met residues.

reduction_concentration: Briefly, precipitated protein pellets were then resuspended 100 mM Tris (pH 8.0) buffer containing 100 mM dithiothreitol and 4% w/v sodium dodecyl sulfate and incubated at 95 °C for 30 min under mild agitation.
reduction_reagent: Briefly, precipitated protein pellets were then resuspended 100 mM Tris (pH 8.0) buffer containing 100 mM dithiothreitol and 4% w/v sodium dodecyl sulfate and incubated at 95 °C for 30 min under mild agitation.
